arxiv-2004-10584.title: The Second-Generation Shifted Boundary Method and Its Numerical Analysis
arxiv-2004-10584.creator: Nabil M. Atallah, Claudio Canuto, Guglielmo Scovazzi
arxiv-2004-10584.description: Abstract Recently, the Shifted Boundary Method (SBM) was proposed within the class of unfitted (or immersed, or embedded) finite element methods. By reformulating the original boundary value problem over a surrogate (approximate) computational domain, the SBM avoids integration over cut cells and the associated problematic issues regarding numerical stability and matrix conditioning.

arxiv-2108-12723.title: Nuclear spin-wave quantum register for a solid state qubit
arxiv-2108-12723.creator: Andrei Ruskuc, Chun-Ju Wu, Jake Rochman, Joonhee Choi, Andrei Faraon
arxiv-2108-12723.description: Abstract Solid-state nuclear spins surrounding individual, optically addressable qubits Awschalom2018 ; Chatterjee2021 provide a crucial resource for quantum networks Briegel1998 ; Hensen2015 ; Bhaskar2020 ; Pompili2021 , computation Waldherr2014 ; Taminiau2014 ; Zhong2019 ; Bradley2019a ; Kinos2021 and simulation Randall2021 .

arxiv-2210-00405.title: Basic Binary Convolution Unit for Binarized Image Restoration Network
arxiv-2210-00405.creator: Bin Xia, Yulun Zhang, Yitong Wang, Yapeng Tian, Wenming Yang , Radu Timofte , and Luc Van Gool
arxiv-2210-00405.description: Abstract Lighter and faster image restoration (IR) models are crucial for the deployment on resource-limited devices. Binary neural network (BNN), one of the most promising model compression methods, can dramatically reduce the computations and parameters of full-precision convolutional neural networks (CNN).

arxiv-2212-00977.title: PSPC: Efficient Parallel Shortest Path Counting on Large-Scale Graphs
arxiv-2212-00977.creator: You Peng, Jeffrey Xu Yu, Sibo Wang
arxiv-2212-00977.description: Abstract In modern graph analytics, the shortest path is a fundamental concept. Numerous recent works concentrate mostly on the distance of these shortest paths. Nevertheless, in the era of betweenness analysis, the counting of the shortest path between s s and t t is equally crucial. It is also an important issue in the area of graph databases.

arxiv-2301-08338.title: Local Geometry of Self-similar Sets: Typical Balls, Tangent Measures and Asymptotic Spectra
arxiv-2301-08338.creator: Manuel Morán, Marta LLorente, María Eugenia Mera
arxiv-2301-08338.description: Abstract We analyse the local geometric structure of self-similar sets with open set condition through the study of the properties of a distinguished family of spherical neighbourhoods, the typical balls. We quantify the complexity of the local geometry of self-similar sets, showing that there are uncountably many classes of spherical neighbourhoods that are not equivalent under similitudes.

arxiv-2306-16958.title: Identifiability of Direct Effects from Summary Causal Graphs including appendix
arxiv-2306-16958.creator: Simon Ferreira, Charles K. Assaad
arxiv-2306-16958.description: Abstract Dynamic structural causal models (SCMs) are a powerful framework for reasoning in dynamic systems about direct effects which measure how a change in one variable affects another variable while holding all other variables constant. The causal relations in a dynamic structural causal model can be qualitatively represented with an acyclic full-time causal graph.

arxiv-2402-00594.title: Identifying relevant Factors of Requirements Quality: an industrial Case Study
arxiv-2402-00594.creator: Julian Frattini
arxiv-2402-00594.description: Abstract [Context and Motivation] : The quality of requirements specifications impacts subsequent, dependent software engineering activities. Requirements quality defects like ambiguous statements can result in incomplete or wrong features and even lead to budget overrun or project failure. [Problem] : Attempts at measuring the impact of requirements quality have been held back by the vast amount of interacting factors.

arxiv-2402-12643.title: Decreasing paths of polygons
arxiv-2402-12643.creator: Isaac Kulp, Charlotte Ochanine, Logan Richard, Leonel Robert, Scott Whitman
arxiv-2402-12643.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Isaac Kulp, Charlotte Ochanine, Logan Richard, Leonel Robert, Scott Whitman. We call a continuous path of polygons decreasing if the convex hulls of the polygons form a decreasing family of sets. For an arbitrary polygon of more than three vertices, we characterize the polygons contained in it that can be reached by a decreasing path (attainability problem), and we show that this can be done by a finite application of “pull-in" moves (bang-bang problem).

arxiv-2402-13451.title: On the Folklore set and Dirichlet spectrum for matrices
arxiv-2402-13451.creator: Mumtaz Hussain, Johannes Schleischitz, Benjamin Ward
arxiv-2402-13451.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mumtaz Hussain, Johannes Schleischitz, Benjamin Ward. We study the Folklore set of Dirichlet improvable matrices in ℝ m × n \mathbb{R}^{m\times n} which are neither singular nor badly approximable. We prove the non-emptiness for all positive integer pairs m , n m,n apart from { m , n } = { 1 , 1 } \{m,n\}=\{1,1\} and { m , n } = { 2 , 3 } \{m,n\}=\{2,3\} in a constructive manner.

arxiv-2408-03838.title: Using a Distance Sensor to Detect Deviations in a Planar Surface
arxiv-2408-03838.creator: Carter Sifferman, William Sun, Mohit Gupta, Michael Gleicher
arxiv-2408-03838.description: Abstract We investigate methods for determining if a planar surface contains geometric deviations ( e.g. , protrusions, objects, divots, or cliffs) using only an instantaneous measurement from a miniature optical time-of-flight sensor. The key to our method is to utilize the entirety of information encoded in raw time-of-flight data captured by off-the-shelf distance sensors.

arxiv-2409-07075.title: Analytical approach for pure high, even-order dispersion solitons
arxiv-2409-07075.creator: Xing Liao, Jiahan Huang, Daquan Lu, Wei Hu
arxiv-2409-07075.description: Abstract We theoretically solve the nonlinear Schrödinger equation describing the propagation of pure high, even order dispersion (PHEODs) solitons by variational approach. The Lagrangian for nonlinear pulse transmission systems with each dispersion order are given and the analytical solutions of PHEOD soltions are obtained and compared with the numerical results.

arxiv-2509-17343.title: Quantum Simulation Programming via Typing
arxiv-2509-17343.creator: Liyi Li, Federico Zahariev, Chandeepa Dissanayake, Jae Swanepoel, Amr Sabry, Mark S. Gordon
arxiv-2509-17343.description: Abstract Quantum simulations are designed to model quantum systems, and many compilation frameworks have been developed for executing such simulations on quantum computers. Most compilers leverage the capabilities of digital and analog quantum computers by representing quantum particle systems with Pauli strings or digital quantum circuits, making it challenging for users in physics, chemistry, and biology to program simulations effectively.

arxiv-2512-08264.title: Mathematical Foundations of Neural Tangents and Infinite-Width Networks Thanks: 1 These authors contributed to the work equally.
arxiv-2512-08264.creator: Rachana Mysore 1 Dept. of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning B.N.M Institute of Technology Bengaluru, India rachanamysore@gmail.com Shrey Kumar Dept. of Computer Science Engineering B.N.M Institute of Technology Bengaluru, India shreysanjeevkumar@gmail.com Preksha Girish 1 Dept. of Artificia
arxiv-2512-08264.description: Abstract We investigate the mathematical foundations of neural networks in the infinite-width regime through the lens of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK). We propose a novel NTK-Eigenvalue-Controlled Residual Network (NTK-ECRN) architecture, integrating Fourier feature embeddings, residual connections with layerwise scaling, and stochastic depth to enable rigorous analysis of kernel evolution during training.

arxiv-2601-06643.title: On Asymptotic Properties of Certain B B -splines in Terms of Theta-like Functions
arxiv-2601-06643.creator: Michael I. Ganzburg
arxiv-2601-06643.description: Abstract . The asymptotic behavior of the Mellin transform of the associated B B -splines B N ∗ ​ ( t ) := t − N ​ B N ​ ( t ) B_{N}^{*}(t):=t^{-N}B_{N}(t) with special knots in terms of theta-like functions is found. The proof is based on polynomial interpolation of power functions and properties of certain theta-like functions.

pmc-11003484.title: Methotrexate, an anti-inflammatory drug, inhibits Hepatitis E viral replication
pmc-11003484.creator: Akash Kumar, Preeti Hooda, Anindita Puri, Radhika Khatter, Mohammed S Al-Dosari, Neha Sinha, Mohammad K Parvez, Deepak Sehgal
pmc-11003484.description: Hepatitis E Virus (HEV) is a positively oriented RNA virus having a 7.2 kb genome. HEV consists of three open reading frames (ORF1-3). Of these, ORF1 codes for the enzymes Methyltransferase (Mtase), Papain-like cysteine protease (PCP), RNA helicase, and RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp).

pmc-11406601.title: Serum Potassium in Thyroid Cancer Patients With Hypothyroidism During Thyroid Hormone Withdrawal: A Retrospective Study
pmc-11406601.creator: Poonyisa Tangsermvong, Wichana Chamroonrat, Siripong Vittayachokkitikhun, Chutintorn Sriphrapradang
pmc-11406601.description: Background:Several case reports and a few studies have reported that hypothyroid patients have elevated serum potassium levels. However, hypothyroidism has not been widely accepted as a cause of hyperkalemia.Objectives:This study aims to evaluate the incidence of hyperkalemia and factors influencing serum potassium levels in thyroid cancer patients with hypothyroidism during thyroid hormone withdrawal before radioactive iodine (RAI) treatment.

pmc-11482559.title: Genetic Variations in the NRF2 Microsatellite Contribute to the Regulation of Bovine Sperm-Borne Antioxidant Capacity
pmc-11482559.creator: Khurshaid Anwar, Georg Thaller, Mohammed Saeed-Zidane, Elena Llano
pmc-11482559.description: Nuclear factor (erythroid-derived 2)-like 2 (NRF2) is a transcription factor protein-coding gene, considered a master regulator of the cellular stress response. The genetic variations of the NRF2 could influence its transcriptional profile and, subsequently, the stress resilience in all cell types, including sperm cells.

pmc-11600155.title: Iridium-Catalyzed Enantioselective Vinylogous and Bisvinylogous Allenylic Substitution
pmc-11600155.creator: Sankash Mitra, Santanu Mukherjee
pmc-11600155.description: Compared to the widely explored enol silanes, the applicability of their extended variants especially as bisvinylogous nucleophiles in enantioselective catalysis has been sparse. Herein, we describe the first enantioselective vinylogous and bisvinylogous allenylic substitution using silyl dienol and trienol ethers, respectively, as a nucleophile.

pmc-11712825.title: Evaluation of multiple ATN biomarker definitions for prediction of cognitive impairment
pmc-11712825.creator: Tom Earnest, Braden Yang, Deydeep Kothapalli, Aristeidis Sotiras
pmc-11712825.description: BackgroundApplication of the amyloid/tau/neurodegeneration (ATN) framework is varied, with some research relying on binary assessment of biomarkers and some using continuous or multidimensional measures. There are few investigations which directly evaluate how differing operationalizations of ATN affect prediction of cognitive impairment.

pmc-11715983.title: Exploring a weighted composite score for harmonization of 18F‐MK6240 and 18F‐ Flortaucipir: linearity and correlations with cognitive measures in a head‐to‐head tau PET dataset – The HEAD Study
pmc-11715983.creator: Quentin Finn, Guilherme Povala, Guilherme Bauer‐Negrini, Andrea Franco, Tam Vo, Firoza Z Lussier, Livia Amaral, Brian A Gordon, William E Klunk, Val J Lowe, Hwamee Oh, Pedro Rosa‐Neto, David N soleimani‐meigooni, Suzanne L Baker, Joseph C Masdeu, Tharick Pascoal, Belen Pascual
pmc-11715983.description: BackgroundHarmonization of the two most commonly used Tau PET tracers, 18F‐Flortaucipir and 18F‐MK6240 has proven to be complex. Unlike the centiloid scale for amyloid tracers, Tau PET SUVRs of the two tracers are not linearly comparable and vary markedly in dynamic range and sensitivity.

pmc-12507880.title: Profiles and influencing factors of pulmonary fibrosis associated with biologic and conventional disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs for autoimmune diseases: a disproportionality study based on FAERS and VigiAccess
pmc-12507880.creator: Xinyue Zhang, Xinhui Wu, Cheng Luo, Chun Yang, Nan Jia, Jiayi He, Qian Chen, Fei Wang
pmc-12507880.description: BackgroundPulmonary fibrosis is a severe and potentially fatal adverse event, and its association with disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs) has raised long-standing concerns. However, systematic investigations on this topic are lacking. This study aims to analyze the drug-specific safety signals, characteristics, and potential patient risk factors of DMARDs-related pulmonary fibrosis.

pmc-12801988.title: Whole-genome survey information revealed the genome characteristics, mitochondrial genome diversity and evolutionary patterns of Stomatopoda species
pmc-12801988.creator: Xiaowen Duan, Yuan Li, Yue Ding, Xinxian Huang, Jiaguang Xiao, Yifei Wang, Fangrui Lou
pmc-12801988.description: BackgroundStomatopoda possess extremely unique biological characteristics and evolutionary process; however, their phylogenetic relationships remain controversial. To avoid gene tree conflicts caused by a small number of genetic markers in previous phylogenetic studies of Stomatopoda, this study provides the first whole-genome survey sequencing data for three Stomatopoda species (Odontodactylus japonicus, Odontodactylus scyllarus, and Lysiosquillina maculata).

pmc-13625347.title: Transfusion-transmitted malaria in sub-Saharan Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis of Plasmodium spp. carriage in blood units and confirmed transmission in recipient
pmc-13625347.creator: Lambert Morisho Mulakwa, Archippe Muhandule Birindwa, Chérone Nancy Mbani Mpega Ntigui, Justin Byamungu Ahadi, Patrick Ntagereka Bisimwa, Sandrine Lydie Oyegue Liabagui
pmc-13625347.description: BackgroundTransfusion-transmitted malaria (TTM) remains a major concern in malaria-endemic regions of Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where routine screening of blood donors for Plasmodium species is rarely implemented. Asymptomatic carriers among donors serve as silent reservoirs of infection, which puts transfusion recipients at substantial risk. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to assess the prevalence of Plasmodium spp.
